question: How do I track my parcel?
answer: Enter your FedEx tracking number (12 or 14 digits) in the chat. You will see status, timeline, and can export history to Excel.

question: How do I get proof of delivery?
answer: After delivery, use the « Download proof of delivery (PDF) » button under the shipment summary. In demo mode (FedEx disabled), a sample PDF is provided.

question: How do I export my tracking history?
answer: Go to History and click « Export Excel », or ask for export in the chat. Daily quotas may apply depending on your account.

question: How do I customize chatbot responses?
answer: Settings → style preferences (tone, options). Your request must be approved by an administrator before it is applied.

question: Login or account issues?
answer: Check your email and password. Employees must be approved by an admin. Use the form below to contact support.
